rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_cervix_screen_n66(
id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,

target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
pap int(9) DEFAULT 0,
via int(9) DEFAULT 0,
hpv int(9) DEFAULT 0,
result int(9) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;


DELETE FROM s_cervix_screen_n66 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_cervix_screen_n66 (id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year,pap,via,hpv,result)
SELECT @id,'00000' as hospcode ,CONCAT(t.amp_code,'0000') as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(date(t.pap_date)>0 OR date(t.pap_d_date)>0, t.CID,NULL)) as pap
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(date(t.via_date)>0 , t.CID,NULL)) as via
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(date(t.hpv_date)>0 , t.CID,NULL)) as hpv
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.result=1 , t.CID,NULL)) as result

FROM t_cervix_screen t INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON t.hospcode=p.hospcode AND t.cid=p.cid
WHERE  LENGTH(TRIM(p.CID)) = 13 
GROUP BY t.amp_code;

UPDATE s_cervix_screen_n66 s INNER JOIN k_ca_pop k ON left(areacode,4)=k.amp_code AND k.b_year=s.b_year AND s.b_year=(@b_year+543)
SET s.target=k.pop_k
WHERE k.cat_id='30_60F' AND k.chw_code=@prov_c;

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_cervix_screen_n66 (id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year,target)
SELECT @id,'00000' as hospcode ,CONCAT(k.amp_code,'0000') as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,SUM(k.pop_k) target
FROM k_ca_pop k WHERE k.cat_id='30_60F' AND k.chw_code=@prov_c
GROUP BY k.amp_code;

zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code, h.zone_name as a_name, SUM(target) as target, SUM(result) as result, SUM(pap) as pap, SUM(via) as via, SUM(hpv) as hpv FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} WHERE ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) GROUP BY h.zone_code, h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
